acceptance: c8ee1a3f with view-ports and the frozen 64-unit catalogs
method: Standard release, sparse-cells, view-ports and storage-metrics, one excluded warm-up per arm and case, then three fresh processes per arm in alternating order. CLI includes load and export. RSS is the process high-water through inference in bytes. Audit process checked every frozen digest.

heldout_pgo.method: Opposite-workload training, native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit. One warm-up (i=0), four alternating measured pairs. Timing builds check schedule and final graph. The separate audit builds check RHS, writes and Spine.

clean_heldout_pgo.method: Each opposite-case-trained executable alternates with the baseline binary in a fresh process. Sample 0 is excluded. Each process checks final state and ordered schedule digest. The fixed historical reference and the contemporary control are reported separately.

typed_control_heldout.method: Four measured alternating pairs after one warm-up, same fixed programs, separate snapshot full audit, native CPU/fat LTO/one codegen unit, trained exclusively on the other case.

ordered_rows_heldout.method: Opposite-case-trained native CPU/fat LTO/one codegen unit. Each clean timing series has one excluded warm-up then seven sum-bits pairs or five Raytrace pairs. Original Raytrace series overlapped an exploratory Python donor analysis and is kept separately, excluded from reported medians.

arithmetic_heldout.method: Alternating fresh processes with one excluded warm-up, seven measured sum-bits pairs and five Raytrace pairs. Native CPU, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Each case tests a binary trained exclusively on the opposite case. Full standalone audit at the same revision.

single_table_words_heldout.method: Fresh paired standard release baseline and native fat-LTO candidate trained on the opposite workload only. One warm-up, nine sum-bits measured pairs and five Raytrace measured pairs. Every timed child checked the schedule and graph. Separate audited executable at same source commit.
